## Game bitmap font sources

These fonts are source material for generating in-game bitmap glyph atlases.
They are not editor GUI fonts and are not embedded as original font files in
GBA ROMs.

- `third_party/font/changban12` — OFL-1.1; license and source in that folder.
- `third_party/font/firefly14` — Arphic Public License; license and source in that folder.
- `third_party/font/zhengge16` — OFL-1.1; license and source in that folder.

See `third_party/font/README.md` and `third_party/font/manifest.json` for
native sizes, source URLs and SHA256 hashes.
